title: Blockmax
description: bm is a Chinese SMP with an AWESOME community!
body:
We are a nonprofit server focused on a semi-vanilla survival experience, featuring a passionate and playful player community, along with a dedicated team of admins who actively solve problems. The server allows redstone engineering, encourages building, and invites players to unleash their endless creativity. We guarantee no server resets, and we've kept that promise for the past two years!


**Other game modes in our network include** (the above description may not fully apply to these sub-servers):

- **Anarchy Survival:** If you want to play freely without restrictions but don't want the rampant hacking found on servers like 2b2t, give our anarchy survival mode a try!
- **Slimefun Skyblock:** Loves skyblock, industrial systems, or automation design? Then our Slimefun Skyblock server will bring you an unforgettable experience!
- **Minigames:** We offer a variety of minigames for players to enjoy (even if no one plays them TAT)! For more details, feel free to contact @oneLiLi in the QQ/WeChat group.
- **More modes are under development.** If you have any suggestions, you can propose them to the admins in the group!

**Community Activities**

- **Events:** Sporadic events and challenges that give players a chance to win in-game rewards and items.
- **Community Building:** Our community members can come together to build, renovate, and maintain our world. Every lobby we have was constructed by our team of builders or even by players themselves!

Our server address is: **mc.bmmc.cc**. Welcome to our realm!

(If you are outside of China, please use `hk.bmmc.cc` for a better experience)
